title: The Java memory model: visibility and reordering

videos.script: Two threads share the same objects. The surprise is that they do not always see the same values in them. {{flag}} Here one thread spins until a flag says stop. The other sets the flag after a second. Three seconds later the first thread is still spinning, and it will spin forever. Nothing is broken. The compiler was allowed to read the flag once. {{order}} Then a stranger result. Two threads, each writes one variable and reads the other. By any order you can imagine, at least one of them must see a one. Out of five million tries, some saw two zeros. {{hb}} The memory model is the set of rules that says when a write in one thread must be visible in another. The word for it is happens-before, and the next three lessons are the tools that create it.
